entries.permitted_wording: Allen VBN is a real negative mechanistic-identifiability case.
blocked_wording: Allen VBN validates a mechanistic brain model.
entries.rationale: The target is reproducible, but topology and direction are not identified.

entries.permitted_wording: Sensorium/Dynamic Sensorium are predictive and interoperability cases.
blocked_wording: MouseBrainBench is a Sensorium SOTA model.
entries.rationale: The official ecosystem can be audited, but the local run is not a SOTA claim.

entries.permitted_wording: Dynamic Sensorium is used as a temporal predictive case.
blocked_wording: Temporal prediction establishes a digital twin.
entries.rationale: The comparator tracks prediction and temporal modeling, not causal circuits.

entries.permitted_wording: MICRONS supports a local observational structure-function case at the fixed endpoint.
blocked_wording: MICRONS proves causality in this study.
MICRONS validates a whole-brain mouse digital twin.
entries.rationale: The endpoint survives harder controls but remains local and observational.

entries.permitted_wording: The non-compensatory gate blocks broad adversarial overclaims.
blocked_wording: The adversarial suite proves biological truth.
entries.rationale: Synthetic cases test claim authorization under known truth.

entries.permitted_wording: The current release passes known attack checks with declared limits.
blocked_wording: All external Q1 pieces are fully solved.
There are no remaining methodological limitations.
entries.rationale: Known medium-risk limitations are part of the release claim.
